question: Ktorý malý nočný návštevník slovenských záhrad si poradí aj s jedovatou vretenicou, pretože je voči jej jedu do veľkej miery odolný?
source_excerpt: Erinacin is an antihaemorrhagic protein first isolated from the European hedgehog, thought to give partial immunity to snake venom.

extra.why_interesting: Players picture the cute garden visitor as harmless prey. Learning that it can take on Slovakia's only venomous snake is a pleasant surprise, and the stem gives enough footholds to guess it.
extra.verification_notes: Hedgehogs are documented as partially resistant to viper venom via erinacin and α-neurotoxin receptor changes; no contradicting or newer information found (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Erinacin).

explanation: Jež má v krvi látky, ktoré oslabujú hadí jed, a vretenicu dokáže uhryznúť a zjesť. Pred jej zubami ho navyše chránia ostne.

question: Vianočný kapor, ktorý pláva vo vani, nemá v papuli ani jeden zub, a predsa potravu drví. Kde má kapor zuby?
source_excerpt: three rows of pharyngeal teeth that are adapted for crushing

extra.why_interesting: Almost every Slovak has seen a Christmas carp in the bathtub, yet few know it has no teeth in its mouth. The answer is logical enough to work out once the player asks how a fish without teeth eats.
extra.verification_notes: Carp lack jaw teeth and have pharyngeal (throat) teeth that grind food against a pad, per https://www.georgiaaquarium.org/animal/common-carp/.

explanation: Kapor má takzvané hltanové zuby hlboko v hrdle a drví nimi potravu o tvrdú platničku. Preto vás pri chytaní do ruky nepohryzie.

question: Bocian, ktorý hniezdi na komínoch slovenských dedín, ako dospelý takmer nevydá hlas. Ako sa teda dorozumieva, napríklad keď sa pár víta na hniezde?
source_excerpt: The adult white stork's main sound is noisy bill-clattering.

extra.why_interesting: Birds are supposed to sing or call, but the stork on a village chimney is nearly mute. Players who have heard a stork's clattering can reason their way to the answer and feel proud.
extra.verification_notes: White storks are essentially voiceless as adults and communicate by bill-clattering, including in greeting at the nest (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_stork).

explanation: Bocian zakloní hlavu až na chrbát a rýchlo klepe zobákom, takže to znie ako kastanety. Mláďatá ešte vedia syčať a pišťať, dospelé vtáky už takmer vôbec nie.

question: Úhor, ktorý žije v európskych riekach a rybníkoch, sa v nich nikdy nenarodil. Vyliahol sa ďaleko za Atlantikom, neďaleko Bermúd. Ako sa volá more, kam sa každý úhor vracia, aby sa rozmnožil?
source_excerpt: Adult European eels undertake a grueling 3,107 to 6,214 mile (5,000 to 10,000 kilometer) migration to the Sargasso Sea, not far from Bermuda, to spawn

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a freshwater fish from a European river or pond was born nearby, like a carp or trout. In fact every European eel starts life on the far side of the Atlantic, near Bermuda, which most players know from the Bermuda Triangle. That gives them a foothold to reach the answer.
extra.verification_notes: The Sargasso Sea, near Bermuda, is the only known spawning area of the European eel, and recent sources still confirm it (https://www.livescience.com/european-eel-spawning).

explanation: Larvy úhorov sa s morskými prúdmi unášajú tisíce kilometrov až k európskym brehom. Dospelý úhor sa po rokoch v sladkej vode vydá na rovnako dlhú cestu späť, aby sa v Sargasovom mori vytrel a uhynul.
